## Verifiering

- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run audit:security`
- [ ] `npm run audit:full` reviewed, including any documented temporary exception
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Berörda vyer kontrollerade på mobil och större skärm
